title: Aoi and Emi as 3D models in the game
caption: Round 2 of Aoi and Emi (Reviews aoi-meshy-1 and emi-meshy-1) now replace their code-built bodies on day 1 and day 2: Aoi in her train seat and on her way out, Emi in B2. Aoi has a smaller head and her hands at 0.75; Emi has no lanyard, and the dark texels along her jaw are repainted in skin.
